name: @bubstack/moe-statusline
description: Configures a vendored, MIT-licensed Claude Code statusline (ccstatusline) automatically on session start.

scripts.build: node ../../scripts/clean-package-dist.mjs && cd ../.. && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/write-bundle-inventory.mjs --prepare packages/statusline && tsc -b packages/statusline/tsconfig.json --force && packages/statusline/node_modules/.bin/tsup --config packages/statusline/tsup.config.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/write-bundle-inventory.mjs packages/statusline packages/statusline/dist/metafile-cjs.json
